# SYNESIS_E066 — Error

## Description

Two PROJECT blocks in the same .synp — remove the duplicate.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
This project file has two PROJECT blocks. Only one PROJECT
  block is allowed per file — the compiler would not know which of
  the two to use as the entry point.
  Remove the duplicate block or split the projects into separate `.synp` files.
```
